newsitem.title: JAPAN: Korea Airport mulling samurai issue - underwriters.
newsitem.headline: Korea Airport mulling samurai issue - underwriters.

text.p: The Korea Airport Construction Authority (KOACA) is considering issuing samurai bonds in the near future, underwriting sources said on Monday.
The issue is likely to be worth 10 billion yen and have a 10-year maturity. It is expected to be lead-managed by Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd, they said.
The bond may be launched this week at the earliest, they said.
On June 6, Japan Bond Research Institute said it had assigned a preliminary double A plus (AA+) rating on bonds to be issued by KOACA.
